name: Cat C18
description: C18 ACERT, 597 bkW (800 bhp) @ 2100 rpm, IND-E rating, DITA twin-turbo. Reference/default engine profile.
notes: Geometry, compression ratio, and the torque/power curve are transcribed verbatim from Caterpillar's published spec sheet (doc SS-9054178-18396700-062, exact match: compression ratio 16.3:1, max torque 3655 N·m @ 1400 rpm, max power 597 kW @ 2100 rpm). The compressor map polynomial, VE curve, and turbine map coefficients are engineering estimates consistent with a twin-turbo DITA arrangement -- not independently dyno-validated against this exact engine's compressor map.

zone_names: Zone 6 — Turbine Outlet / Pre-Aftertreatment (Turbo outlet → DPF inlet)

action_map.1: Inspect intake ducting between airflow meter and compressor inlet. Check hose clamps and silicone couplers.
action_map.2: Check boost pipe connections between compressor outlet and CAC inlet. Inspect for cracked charge pipes.
action_map.3: Inspect CAC-to-intake manifold connections. Check CAC end tanks and pipe clamps.
action_map.4: Inspect exhaust manifold gaskets and V-band clamps. Check turbocharger turbine housing bolts.
action_map.5: Inspect DPF/SCR connections. Check DOC mounting bolts and exhaust pipe V-bands.
action_map.6: Inspect turbine outlet-to-DPF inlet ducting and joints. Check for cracked/loose pre-aftertreatment piping.
